provenance.provider: Public Backtrader historical fixture, not TrendSpider

methodology.allocation: Five independent $2,000 sleeves; no sleeve rebalancing
methodology.execution: Previous completed close signal; following open fills; terminal close liquidation
methodology.costs: 5 bps commission + 5 bps adverse slippage on each side
methodology.dividends: Excluded; reported split-adjusted OHLC used as supplied
methodology.parameters: Fixed before tests; no tuning on test windows
limitations: One historical stock and old data only
No licensed TrendSpider historical feed connected
Not proof of profitability or independent out-of-sample validation
Fractional shares; no minimum fees, taxes, FX costs or market-impact model
No trained AI model and no live brokerage execution

strategies.name: Moving average
strategies.description: Long when the 10-bar simple average exceeds the 30-bar average; otherwise cash.
strategies.adaptation: Upstream MACD script actually uses simple moving averages. Fixed 10/30 windows, full warmup and next-open execution.

strategies.name: RSI reversal
strategies.description: Wilder RSI: enter below 30, hold until RSI reaches 55, otherwise cash.
strategies.adaptation: Uses the upstream RSI idea; replaces short/flat threshold positions with a long-only stateful 30/55 rule.

strategies.name: Bollinger bands
strategies.description: Enter below the 20-bar mean minus two sample standard deviations; exit at the mean.
strategies.adaptation: Uses upstream bands; replaces scale-dependent W-pattern thresholds with a basic mean-reversion rule. Not the original W-pattern script.

strategies.name: Parabolic SAR
strategies.description: Long during the bullish SAR state; acceleration rises from .02 to .20.
strategies.adaptation: Causal recursive SAR with previous-bar clamps, 30-bar warmup and next-open fills.

strategies.name: Heikin-Ashi
strategies.description: Enter after two bullish candles with no lower wick and expanding body; exit after two bearish candles.
strategies.adaptation: Upstream enters long on bearish HA candles. This variant deliberately reverses that direction, caps exposure at one long position and trades real OHLC prices.
